name: deja-history
title_zh: 翻旧账前先问一句「上次怎么解决的」
tagline_zh: 你说「这错以前修过」时，它替你翻出当时的完整对话——不用重查 Git 历史，不用凭记忆猜。
tagline_en: When you say 'we fixed this before', it digs up that exact session—no Git archaeology, no guessing. See the old.
desc_en: Search the user's past AI coding sessions. Use when they say things like 'didn't we fix this before', 'what did we decide about X', or before re-debugging an error that may already be solved.
why_zh: 别的搜索找文件名，它找的是「你当时解决问题的思路轨迹」——按语义匹配对话片段。
why_en: Others search filenames; this traces your past problem-solving path. Semantic matching on conversation fragments, so even 'that.
limit_zh: 只搜本机已保存的 AI 编程会话记录；没装配套记录插件或历史已清理则空手而归。不读 Git 提交。
limit_en: Only searches locally saved AI coding sessions; requires companion logging plugin, no Git/IDE history. Returns conversation excerpts, not patches.
title_en: Ask 'how did we fix this' before re-debugging
